aboutHtml:
Shane Taylor has built STIHL SHOP Onehunga on years of technical knowledge and genuine customer service in the outdoor power industry. We serve homes and contractors across Onehunga and Penrose, stocking STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda Power Equipment, Hansa Chippers and Ziegler & Brown.

We stock new equipment and keep machines running with service and repair. We supply parts and offer advice grounded in real experience. You can order online for home delivery, or come in for Click & Collect when you need something today.

We're part of the Onehunga community and support local schools and causes. Call in and see us. We'll help you find what works for your job and keep it going.
